unresolved_ambiguity.summary: Roadmap and executed numbering disagree for roadmap P2, P3, P4 and P5.
unresolved_ambiguity.detail: Executed P2/P3/P4/P5 are Capability Intelligence, Production Capability, Production Promotion and Implementation/Integration. Roadmap P2/P3/P4/P5 are Core Orchestration & Governance, Agent Interoperability, Capability Discovery and Dynamic Skill Selection. Only roadmap P1 and P6 align.
unresolved_ambiguity.why_it_matters: Roadmap P7 declares dependencies 'P2, P3'. Read as roadmap numbers, P7 depends on roadmap P2 (substantially satisfied) and roadmap P3 (implemented under D-P3-F; User approval of the delivered state pending). Read as executed numbers, it depends on executed P2 and P3, which are satisfied. The dependency has two opposite readings.
unresolved_ambiguity.resolution: Resolved by explicit User decision recorded in sps2/decisions/P7-READINESS-DECISIONS.json. The ambiguity is closed as a DECISION; the underlying work it describes remains OUTSTANDING and is now a tracked prerequisite.

unresolved_ambiguity.resolution: Resolved by explicit User decisions recorded in sps2/decisions/P7-READINESS-DECISIONS.json and sps2/decisions/ROADMAP-P3-DECISIONS.json.
